We find ourselves bored at the moment. Can you perform any tricks?
We have enjoyed seafood since our earliest days and would like to savor Dagdan specialties with you.
We are from Brigid, which is a kingdom that loves nature. So we enjoy our time with you.
We deem you worthy of our protection, so if you’re ever in trouble, please let us handle it
You must visit our kingdom. We would feed and entertain you magnificently!
We are very fond of the people of Brigid. So if you see any, please tell us, alright?
You remind us of the spirits of our homeland. Perhaps we are connected somehow.
To learn the ways of a foreign land, there’s no better way than to mingle with its people, right?
We hope to take Lade Ultand as our queen, though some consider her rank in society too low for us.
It’s nice to walk around the forest and listen to all the sounds the animals make, huh?
What should I do when I get so scared my legs start shaking and I can’t move?
I had a dream about a beautiful bird… I wonder if it was a friend of yours.
I look at you and... You make me feel like I can face even the most difficult things in life.
Everyone’s fighting. It’s scary, but I’m doing my best!
There’s a ginji tree not far from here. We should go together and pick some of the fruit!
I like clouds. They’re so big, and it’s neat to see all the shapes they can take.
Taking it easy makes me sleepy… Hey, if I fall asleep, will you wake me up?
Some animals make all kinds of racket. But you don’t do that, do you?
I just don’t know what to do about these feelings I have for Tialla.
I enjoy writing fables. Are there any tales shared among birds? I’d love to hear them.
Care to join me fishing? It’s nice to spend time idly, casting a fishing line.
I like lending a hand to those already trying to help themselves. Does that make me a meddler?
Do you detect anything… strange about how I look? I don’t want to stand out.
People tell me I have a stern look much of the time. Do I really seem so harsh?
My daughter is currently in a long slumber. I hope to be at her side by the time she awakens.
Despite appearances, I carry more concerns than most people. Could I rest at your side awhile?
The land of Dagda is full of interesting things. It’d be fascinating to explore it with you.
Your white appearance reminds of someone very close to me. I’d like a closer look.
I'm documenting all in this land to share with future generations. I'd like to look at you, please.
You’re quite calm around humans. Aren’t you afraid of creatures bigger than you?
Our mission, the hopes of the villagers… It’s all important, but so is protecting family, right?
I have no idea what birds eat. Maybe you could let me try one of your meals sometime?
I’m always drawn to people older than me. My first love was like that. Is that why I can’t forget them?
It can be wonderful traveling the outside world. But it does get scary sometimes.
Your eyes are so charming. I wonder how mine look to you?
I love taking care of others. Do you think I could preen your feathers sometime?
If I’d remained in the village, I could be holding a baby in my arms.
You’ve seen the world from up in the sky. I wish I spoke bird language. I bet you have a lot of stories.
I’m always a little wary of talking to people from the temples. What about you?
It’s not too hard to be a merc, really. Fly over a battlefield, and maybe you’ll see some in action!
Nosy people drive me up the wall. You know what I mean?
Just because my ancestors were from Damascar doesn’t mean I pray to Yu Phas too.
Now, if I could fly from battlefield to battlefield? Man, that would be the life
You’re a strange one, aren’t you? An animal that cares about living longer is usually more careful.
Launching a surprise attack is probably easier if you can fly, huh? As long as no archers are around.
Sometimes, even when I’m not on the battlefield, I feel this… tension in me, you know?
You know, I’ve always liked carving little wooden statues. Maybe, one day, I’ll carve you.
You’re in the pink of health. Like you could survive anywhere.
In the field, nice guys always die fast. One minute, they’re cracking jokes, and the next… they’re gone.
The women of Kalla’s temple are no longer seduced by my poetry. What else could I do to woo them?
I’m envied by most men. Not that it’s any wonder why. I mean, have you looked at me?
I am confident in my memory. No doubt I could recognize you amidst a flock of winged creatures.
Considering my own skill in music, I thought we might enjoy playing a song together. What say you?
One must see the world in all its contours to melt others’ hearts as I do.
I detest shabby men. The sight of them sours my spirits. Is there something you similarly loathe?
The name given to me by my lady Kalla is so excellent. Do you like your own name?
A bird’s instrument is its chirp, but I’m no less skilled with my own. Would you like to hear?
It was during a hailstorm that I was left at Kalla’s temple. So when you see hail, think of me.
Kalla is too resplendent for words. You ought to admire for yourself what a marvel she is.
Don’t you think Lord Solel is wonderful? He’s so kind, amazing, and just plain great!
I like to give everyone cute little names. I hope it’s cute anyway. Maybe it’s kind of weird?
Be careful not to get too near me when I’m really hungry. You do look delicious, I’m sorry to say.
I was born and raised at Lyoshan Fort. If you ever go there, watch out for all the ruffians!
Mmm, roasted? Braised? Oh! Sorry, I didn’t mean anything by it. You don’t look tasty at all!
If I think someone’s cute, I can’t help calling them a fun name. I’m going to call you Li’l Birdie!
I grew up enjoying food at my dad’s feasts with his friends. If I have a big party like that, want to come?
I never get tipsy, no matter how many mugs of suds I drink. How about you?
I have a VERY healthy appetite. The pay I get from the temple can’t cover my meals. Tragic, right?
I love spicy food more than anything. Too bad it always gets eaten up quick. Why is that, I wonder?
My retainers winces at the sight of the sketches I enjoy drawing. I blame this new arm of mine.
As a child of Damascar, I cannot be expected to place my trust in the temples.
In truth, I have no fondness for insects. Do you eat them often?
As a child, I used to fall asleep listening to bedtime stories and lullabies.
There is a firm resolve in your eyes not often seen in birds.
We see ourselves as indebted to Yu Phas, so we cannot help but afford her the proper reverence.
I have considered training my spear technique against you. Surely you can avoid my blows.
I yearn to be a queen that Yu Phas and the people of Saramis can take pride in.
I find myself somewhat weary of late...
If I can make this world a place where my people can thrive, I will consider myself satisfied.
You have such beautiful plumage. Do you mind if I take a closer look?
These glasses are pretty nice, don’t you think? They’re a hand-me-down from my grandfather.
I can see such intelligence in your eyes. I think we could get along.
Technique is important, yes. But without knowledge of why it works, it won’t be of much use.
If something bad is going to happen no matter what, is there any point in fighting it?
I like to lie in the warm sun. Do you like it too?
I might be inexperienced, but I’ve studied hard and learned more than most people!
I’ll always remember being with Grandpa when I was little. We heard a bard sing the prettiest song.
I’d love to be a bird. I’d fly through the open windows and right into the temple library.
It’s bad to overthink things, isn’t it? It makes your head go all fuzzy.
I love a good party! I wish we could have one every day.
Gettin’ old doesn’t stop a guy from dominating on the battlefield. You know what I’m saying?
Wine, mead, meat, and fish! That’s what I call a full meal!
It’s not a bad thing to drink until you fall asleep, is it?
I can still hold my own against anyone half my age!
(yawn) I’m in the mood for some shuteye.
It happened again! Some folks saw me and crossed the street. Am I really that scary-lookin’?
You look like you wouldn’t taste so good.
I like to sing when I work. Puts me in a good mood.
Hey, is it a problem to go a few glasses past your limit?
I can save money, yes, but I feel like the odds are low that it’ll start increasing on its own.
You’re so cute! Can I take you home with me?
I feel like sometimes there’s just no avoiding snapping at your superiors.
Do you think I’ll have a happy family in the future?
I’ve noticed something interesting. I find just looking at you to be unusually soothing.
I’ve been so exhausted lately. I could really do with some pampering …
I think this hairstyle is quite lovely. What do you think?
What do you do when there’s someone you like and you want them to notice you?
I enjoy a good fish dinner, but you can’t eat nothing but fish every day, can you?
I could listen to bards sing all day. Their songs are so lovely.
I know I can’t return home… But… sometimes I can’t help but pine for what’s gone…
In my homeland, I lived a life of hiding… But in Dagda, I’m free to be myself. Do you like it here?
I can’t stand a messy desk. If it’s just a little bit out of sorts, I get an overwhelming urge to clean it.
You seem far sharper than the average bird. How would you like to be a pet at the company?
To be honest, sometimes I get so annoyed at my own jealous feelings. I wish I could control them better…
Your feathers are simply gorgeous. Perhaps, one day, I can draw your portrait.
Hey… If you ever see me become a beast, remember that you mustn’t approach me, alright?
I can’t read your thoughts like other animals… Are you really a bird?
Back then, when I was being hunted for my crest, I thought if I was a bird, maybe I could just fly away.
Talimun has saved me in far more ways than one. Attending his misadventures is a small price to pay.
There is a saying that a bird flown from the coop is truly still close to home. Does that sound right?
If birds have hearts, I wonder what kind beats under those feathers of yours.
When my body has perished, and I float as a soul, let’s frolic in the sky. What do you say?
To live or die… To be tipsy or sober…These are similar states in a fleeting world. Don’t you agree?
I’ve heard of a monstrous bird who turned perfectly good wine into poison. I trust that’s not you?
I have the odor of hitting the bottles too heavily. Yet you don’t mind. Do you enjoy a tipsy drink?
To think that I've put myself in the care of such a group of people. Fate is strange, isn't it?
Practicing silence was part of my training. How about you give it a try?
Some say that belief is the same as not thinking. I disagree. Not thinking is entirely different.
Birdsong makes everything better. It pairs especially well with a fine drink. Wouldn’t you say?
There’s no way I can give up on pillaging now! You know how many years I’ve been at it?
Got parents? If you don’t, you’d fit in with me and my pals just fine. You could join our bandit crew!
People think bandits eat nothin’ but meat. It’s vegetables all the way with me. Keep that in mind.
The guys in the Gaia Brigade left me for dead as soon as we lost our battle in the games. Cruel, huh?
Good idea not fighting anyone who looks too dangerous. WHoever lasts longest... wings, right?
I thought I could get anything I want through plunder and fighting. But how can I get myself a family...
It’s common sense to pick off the weaklings in battle. You look like easy prey to me!
The mountains are like home to me. I should build me and my pals a castle up there, right?
If anyone gets robbed or snuffed out … they shouldn’t be so weak! Fight harder, that’s what I say!
Weaklings like you end up as dinner. So try to fly extra-high so the arrows don’t get you.
